pillars.title: AI Training Data Creation
pillars.text: Annotation of 3D LiDAR data and 2D image data, with multi-layer quality checks.

annotation.lead: We turn raw LiDAR and camera data into model-ready training data — precisely labeled, checked through multiple layers and delivered on time.

highlights.title: 3D & 2D
highlights.text: LiDAR point clouds, camera images and satellite imagery

highlights.title: 550 people · 235+ projects
highlights.text: Large scale, on time, trusted by clients

modalities.label: 3D (LiDAR)
modalities.title: 3D data from LiDAR scanners
modalities.text: LiDAR produces point clouds that describe the 3D space around a vehicle. We label directly on the point cloud so AI can understand the shape, position and distance of objects.

types.name: SEGMENT
types.title: 3D Segment – label every point
types.summary: Every point in the cloud receives an object class such as road surface, building, vegetation, vehicle or pedestrian.
points: Semantic labels for every single point
Suited to high-definition mapping and scene understanding
Done with dedicated tools on LiDAR data

types.name: BOUNDING BOX
types.title: 3D Bounding Box (Cuboid) – 3D boxes
types.summary: Each object is enclosed in a 3D box that defines its position, size and heading.
points: Locates vehicles, pedestrians, two-wheelers and more in 3D space
Core data for object detection in autonomous driving and driver assistance
A business area we have expanded strongly since 2025

modalities.label: 2D (Image)
modalities.title: 2D data from images
modalities.text: Images from dashcams mounted around the vehicle, plus satellite imagery, are labeled so AI can recognize objects, regions and poses.

types.name: SEGMENT
types.title: 2D Segment – label every pixel
types.summary: Every pixel receives an object class (road, lane, vehicle, person, sky…) so AI understands the whole scene.
points: Captures exact shapes of objects and regions
Used for lane recognition, drivable areas and street scenes
Original and result can be compared side by side

types.name: BOUNDING BOX
types.title: 2D Bounding Box – rectangles
types.summary: Rectangles are drawn around each object (vehicles, people, signs…) so AI learns to detect them.
points: Fast and efficient for large volumes of data
Foundation for object detection on dashcam images
Consistent labels through standard guidelines and multi-layer checks

types.name: KEYPOINT
types.title: Keypoint – landmark points
types.summary: Marks landmark points such as body joints so AI can estimate pose and motion.
points: Used for pose recognition and motion analysis
Each point follows one consistent rule set

types.name: SATELLITE
types.title: Satellite imagery
types.summary: Objects in satellite images (e.g., aircraft, structures) are labeled so AI can recognize them from above.

workflow.title: How we work
workflow.lead: Every project follows four clear stages, with close coordination between the customer, BPO Japan and BPO Vietnam.

steps.title: Intake & trial measurement
steps.text: Receive the request, trial-measure volume and difficulty, and agree the order with the customer.

steps.title: Team set-up & training
steps.text: Build the team, prepare the work environment, hold the kickoff and train to the project guideline.

steps.title: Production & review
steps.text: Annotate and review through multiple layers; interim deliveries bring customer feedback (FB).

steps.title: Delivery & retrospective
steps.text: Final delivery, acceptance and lessons learned for the next project.

quality.lead: Data reaches the customer only after five layers of work and approval. If any layer finds an error, the data is sent back, corrected and cycled through the layers until it meets the requirement.

layers.desc: Labels the data following the project guideline.
Quality check layer 1: finds errors and requests fixes.
Quality check layer 2: re-examines the result of round 1.
Overall review of quality and consistency of the batch.
Final approval before delivery to the customer.

quality.loop_label: Cycles through the layers until it passes

principles.title: Independent layers
principles.text: The person who annotates and the person who checks are separate roles.

principles.title: Corrective loop
principles.text: Errors go back to the right layer to be fixed and re-checked.

principles.title: Standards & training
principles.text: One guideline and training before production starts.

usecases.title: What is labeled data used for?

items.title: Autonomous driving & ADAS
items.text: Helps vehicles recognize other vehicles, pedestrians, lanes and drivable areas.

items.title: Mapping & remote sensing
items.text: Satellite images and point clouds support mapping and monitoring of structures.

items.title: Robotics & smart cities
items.text: Object and space recognition for robots and traffic cameras.

items.title: Motion analysis
items.text: Body keypoints help estimate pose and movement.

security.title: Information security
security.text: Customer information is strictly protected under the company's information security rules.

cta.text: Tell us your data type and requirements.

org.title: Organization structure
org.lead: Driven by large-scale data demand, the division operates with a large workforce organized into management and quality-check levels.

process.title: Operating flow
process.lead: The work flow among the Customer, BPO (JP) and BPO (VN) across three stages: early, middle and final.
process.edge_note: Edge m9->m4 is the feedback loop back to production. Layout reference: docs/reference/slide18_operating_flow.png

people.title: People trained in Vietnam and in Japan
people.lead: Our team is trained in Vietnam and, through a company policy, sent to Japan to study and work — strengthening capability and assuring the quality of both work and products.

steps.title: Training in Vietnam
steps.text: Members are trained on each project's guideline before production starts.

steps.title: Study & work in Japan
steps.text: Members are dispatched to Brycen Japan to study, work and experience the mindset and working style of a Japanese office.

steps.title: Applied back in the division
steps.text: The experience is brought back to raise the quality of work and of products delivered to customers.

recruit.title: People & recruitment
recruit.text: Hiring needs may grow to meet new challenges. We work closely with universities, colleges and local ward/commune authorities to recruit, so we can always staff large-scale projects.

stats.label: Current staff studying at the University of Economics

roadmap.title: Growth roadmap
roadmap.lead: We will keep growing annotation in both scale and quality — not only in Japan but globally.

stages.title: United States
